entities.summary: Aragonese, a notable figure in the history of Malta, associated with Arab, Norman, and Medieval Malta (1091–1530). Preceded by Norman and Medieval Feudal Rule and Arab conquest of Malta — origins of the Maltese language's Semitic roots. Their legacy influenced Arrival of the Knights (1530).
